She just kind of stared at it, then got up and went outside alone. Everyone was staring at me at this point and I thought it was better I just went outside too to talk to her. She told me she was humiliated and that I stepped out of line and they I came off as a controlling jerk. Public shaming is never justified, and it damaged your relationship more than it addressed the issue. **Answer: 1** (You’re the asshole).
